title: The Italian Renaissance
description: Harmony, perspective, and humanism from the rebirth of classical ideals.

items.title: Virgin and Child with an Angel
items.description_narrative: Sandro Botticelli's "Virgin and Child with an Angel" depicts Mary holding the Christ Child, with a young angel present. Executed in tempera on panel, this work showcases the tender expressions and delicate forms characteristic of the artist's style.

items.title: Virgin and Child with Two Angels
items.description_narrative: Sandro Botticelli's 'Virgin and Child with Two Angels' showcases the tender intimacy between Mary and Christ, flanked by attendant angels. Executed in tempera on panel, this work exemplifies the luminous palette and delicate draftsmanship characteristic of late 15th-century Florentine art.
items.tags: religious art, madonna, virgin and child, angels, renaissance, italian, devotional, sacred

items.title: Portrait Bust of a Young Man
items.medium: Brush and brown ink and brown and gray wash, over traces of graphite, on ivory wove paper, tipped on to tan laid paper with gray fibers
items.description_narrative: This drawing, titled 'Portrait Bust of a Young Man,' is executed with brush and brown ink alongside brown and gray wash. Rendered on ivory wove paper, it captures the subject with detailed and expressive draftsmanship.
items.tags: portrait, drawing, young man, ink wash, bust, paper, figure study

items.title: Self-Portrait
items.description_narrative: This self-portrait by Walter Shirlaw offers a direct gaze, capturing the artist's likeness with a palpable sense of his presence. Created in 1878 using oil on canvas, the work exemplifies his personal engagement with portraiture.
items.tags: self-portrait, portraiture, oil painting, 19th century, american art, realism, figurative, introspective

items.title: Martin Vanden Bogaert Desjardins
items.medium: Engraving and etching on cream wove paper
items.description_narrative: Gérard Edelinck's engraving and etching depicts Martin Vanden Bogaert Desjardins. This detailed print captures the likeness of the subject through Edelinck's skilled use of engraving and etching techniques.
items.tags: portrait, engraving, etching, printmaking, formal, 17th century art, man

items.title: Remembrance of Italy
items.description_narrative: Jean-Baptiste Camille Corot’s "Remembrance of Italy" is an etching showcasing the artist's mastery in printmaking. Through delicate lines on tan laid paper, Corot evokes a serene, idealized landscape reminiscent of the Italian countryside.
items.tags: landscape, etching, Barbizon School, 19th century, French art, romanticism, pastoral, serene

items.title: Priest and Boy
items.medium: Watercolor over graphite on cream wove paper
items.description_narrative: This artwork depicts a priest and a young boy, rendered with a sensitive hand. Executed in watercolor over graphite on cream wove paper, the piece showcases the artist's mastery of the delicate medium.
items.tags: watercolor, graphite, figure study, religious subject, drawing, paper art

items.title: Upraised Right Hand, with Palm Facing Outward: Study for Saint Peter
items.medium: Black chalk, heightened with white chalk and lead white, partially oxidized, over stylus underdrawing, on cream laid paper
items.description_narrative: This intricate drawing, 'Upraised Right Hand, with Palm Facing Outward: Study for Saint Peter', by Raphael showcases a detailed anatomical study. Executed in black chalk, heightened with white, it demonstrates the artist's masterful preparatory work for a larger composition.
items.tags: renaissance, religious, drawing, black chalk, preparatory study, italian, figure study

items.title: Still Life—Strawberries, Nuts, &c.
items.description_narrative: Raphaelle Peale's 'Still Life—Strawberries, Nuts, &c.', painted in oil on wood panel in 1822, meticulously renders a modest array of fruit and nuts. This work exemplifies her precise command of realism, imbuing ordinary objects with a palpable presence.
items.tags: still life, strawberries, nuts, realism, oil painting, American art, 19th century

items.title: Guard Drawing His Sword
items.medium: Black chalk on tan laid paper, edge mounted on buff laid paper
items.description_narrative: This drawing captures a dynamic figure, a guard in the act of drawing his sword, rendered with black chalk on tan laid paper. Raphael’s masterful use of line and shadow conveys motion and tension.
items.tags: drawing, figure study, renaissance, black chalk, action, dynamism, guard, sword

items.title: Head of Comity
items.medium: Red chalk on cream laid paper, laid down on cream wove paper
items.description_narrative: This red chalk drawing, 'Head of Comity', presents a detailed study on cream laid paper. Created by Raphael around 1750, it showcases a focused rendering of a head.
items.tags: drawing, red chalk, figure study, academic, classical, head

items.title: Psyche Presenting the Phial of Water to Venus
items.medium: Red chalk, with traces of graphite, on cream laid paper
items.description_narrative: This delicate 18th-century drawing, attributed to Raphael, depicts Psyche reverently presenting a phial of water to Venus. Rendered in red chalk with graphite traces on cream laid paper, it captures a moment of mythological narrative with graceful precision.
items.tags: mythology, classical, drawing, red chalk, allegorical, graceful

items.title: Joanna of Aragon
items.medium: Black chalk with red chalk on ivory laid paper
items.description_narrative: This drawing depicts Joanna of Aragon, executed by the renowned Renaissance artist Raphael. Rendered in black and red chalk on ivory laid paper, it showcases the artist's masterful draftsmanship.
items.tags: portrait, renaissance, drawing, chalk, italian, study, female subject

items.title: Conversion of Saint Paul
items.medium: Red chalk on ivory laid paper, laid down on wood pulp board
items.description_narrative: This vivid red chalk drawing captures the dramatic moment of Saint Paul's conversion, where a divine light strikes him from his horse. The intricate detailing on ivory laid paper illustrates the profound spiritual encounter on the road to Damascus.
items.tags: conversion of saint paul, religious, biblical, red chalk, dramatic, spiritual, divine intervention

items.title: Allegory of Venus and Cupid
items.description_narrative: This oil on canvas painting, titled 'Allegory of Venus and Cupid,' depicts a classical mythological scene. Created around 1600, it is attributed to an imitator of the renowned Venetian master Titian.
items.tags: allegory, mythology, classical, oil painting, titian follower, 17th century

items.title: Tobias and the Angel
items.medium: Pen and black ink, with brush and gray wash, on ivory laid paper
items.description_narrative: This drawing by Titian depicts the biblical narrative of Tobias and the Angel, a scene where the young Tobias is guided on his journey. Rendered with expressive pen and black ink, complemented by brush and gray wash, it showcases the artist's masterful draftsmanship.
items.tags: biblical, religious, renaissance, italian, drawing, ink, narrative

items.title: The Submersion of Pharaoh's Army in the Red Sea
items.medium: Woodcut in black on ivory laid paper
items.description_narrative: Titian's monumental woodcut, "The Submersion of Pharaoh's Army in the Red Sea," vividly illustrates the biblical narrative of Pharaoh's forces being engulfed. Created around 1515, this grand composition is renowned for its dramatic depiction of the Old Testament event.
items.tags: biblical narrative, Old Testament, Renaissance, Venetian school, woodcut, epic, dramatic, religious art

items.title: Self-Portrait
items.medium: Black chalk, with stumping, on gray wove paper, tipped on to ivory laid paper
items.description_narrative: This introspective self-portrait by Titian captures the artist's likeness with profound skill. Rendered in black chalk with stumping on gray paper, the drawing showcases a master's command of light and shadow to define form.
items.tags: self-portrait, titian, renaissance, drawing, chalk, portraiture, venetian, introspective
